Manila Rallies! Corruption Scandal EXPOSED 🚨 

Tens of thousands protested in Manila over a massive flood-control corruption scandal implicating top officials. President Marcos Jr. promises arrests by Christmas! 

The three-day rally, organized by the Iglesia ni Cristo (INC), drew an estimated 650,000 people demanding accountability for billions of dollars in missing flood mitigation funds. Protesters camped out in Rizal Park, many bearing signs reading 'expose the deeds'. This could spell trouble for President Marcos Jr., as the INC’s voting bloc carries significant political weight. Talk about a bombshell!

data.raw_text:
IN PHOTOS: Students from the Ateneo de Manila University, University of the Philippines Diliman, and Miriam College gathered earlier today for the One Katipunan Against Corruption movement. The three universities held separate assemblies before converging at the Santa Maria della Strada Parish for a joint program marking International Students’ Day.

This movement was organized by the three schools in response to ongoing discussions about corruption involving national officials. Moreover, the rally aims to echo organizers’ calls for justice, accountability, and a continued commitment to the long history of student activism.
 
Photos by Joseph Castillo, RJ Hernandez, Aidyn Grey Monteras, and Patrick Reyes-Santos
